hesitations.reason: The Application line names anti-vehicle and anti-infantry. roles.primary step 1 says to skip a role whose requires fail (anti-armour fails, since the weapon's damage is psionic), and also that a line naming two roles goes to the bonus test, then on to the next step if neither has a bonus. I applied the skip first, which leaves one named role. Running the two-role bonus test first finds no bonus, and step 5 then gives assault. The rule does not say which comes first.

hesitations.chosen: Overload as its own passive ability (Brainwave overload) with empty patterns and a fit_note proposing overload-past-cap

The wiki gives the Overloaded state its own section and the game announces it, but no source lists it as an ability, perk, upgrade or loadout pick (the abilities rule's parenthesis). The convention also says an effect that is part of how a weapon works stays in that weapon.
The passive/triggered tie-break: the overload is a lasting state while the captive count is over the limit, not a one-off effect per event.

ModEnc MindControl says the effect lands at once whether or not the shot hits, so I read it as hitscan. But the control link stays on each captive, which could be read as a held beam. The delivery rule does not cover an instant hit that leaves a lasting link.

unclear_rules.topic: roles.primary step 1: skip versus the two-role bonus test
unclear_rules.note: When an official line names two roles and one fails its requires, the rule does not say whether to skip that role first (leaving one named role, used directly) or to run the bonus test on both and go on when neither has a bonus. Here that is the difference between anti-infantry and assault for the Mastermind, and the same question will come up for the Yuri Clone and the Brute.

unclear_rules.topic: Passive effects that a source names only as a state
unclear_rules.note: The Weapons vs abilities convention says a passive is its own ability when the source names the effect and it adds a mechanic. The abilities rule narrows that to naming 'as an ability, perk, upgrade or loadout pick'. A state with its own wiki section and voice line (the Mastermind's overload) fits the first wording but not clearly the second.

unclear_rules.topic: Delivery of an instant hit that leaves a lasting link
unclear_rules.note: Mind control takes effect at once (hitscan by the delivery rule), but the link then stays on the target the way a held beam would. The delivery list does not cover this.

unclear_rules.topic: Frames to seconds for RA2 cooldown bands
unclear_rules.note: The registry gives no game frame rate for RA2. The wiki converts frames to seconds at 60 per second on the Chaos drone page and at 15 per second on the Mastermind page. A registry note giving the conversion at normal multiplayer speed would settle every RA2 cooldown band.

unclear_rules.topic: mind-control pattern summary against the registry note
unclear_rules.note: The registry pattern summary says 'for a short time', but RA2 control lasts until the controller dies. The Game-wide mechanics note still assigns mind-control to the Mastermind, Yuri Clone, Yuri Prime and Psi Commando. The Pattern links convention says the summary wins over patterns.md, but it does not cover a summary that conflicts with a games-r1 note.

unclear_rules.topic: Mount when the body has a turret-like part the source does not describe
unclear_rules.note: The aim tie-break falls back to the family default when the source says nothing. With body plan hull-turret, step 5 would give slow-turret for a large ground unit's main turret, and the rule does not say which wins.

Bands with numbers forbids figures for prices, speeds, reaches, sight, cooldowns, damage and armour. It does not say whether an effect's duration (berserk for about ten seconds) is allowed as a figure.

The lineage rule's test (same or nearly the same name, same job) links RA2's Mastermind with the Scrin Mastermind of Tiberium Wars, although the designs differ a lot. It is unclear whether the 'same design' wording should block that.

new_mechanics.summary: The unit captures or controls enemies with a safe limit but no hard cap and no way to stop. Past the limit it takes damage at intervals, faster with each extra captive, and recovers only by losing captives (spending them in battle or getting rid of them). Counterplay: rush it with many cheap, expendable units so it grabs more than it can hold and burns itself out, and use immune units and aircraft it cannot take.

source_problems:
The Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) reset every connection from this session, and WebFetch refused the domain too. I had downloaded the Chaos Drone's profile page (newunits-yuri2.jsp) earlier in the session. I could not re-fetch the Mastermind's profile (newunits-yuri3.jsp), so I read it from the copy-check cache file in .cache/sources/web.archive.org, fetched by the tool on 2026-10-20; the source note says so.

Problems in the sources themselves:
- The official profiles are out of date in places. The Mastermind's says five captives are safe, against three on the wiki and CNCNZ. The Chaos Drone's gives the launch price and a Psychic Radar requirement.
- CNCNZ's price for the Chaos Drone matches neither the wiki infobox nor the profile.
- The wiki converts game frames to seconds at different rates on the Chaos drone and Mastermind pages, and the Mastermind page's overload heading and first bullet disagree on the damage interval.
- The wiki's Yuri (faction) page says the gas affects only infantry and speaks of the Mastermind as being on wheels; both contradict the unit pages and pictures.
- Neither unit's running gear (tracks, wheels) is named in any text; both come from the wiki pages' render and voxel images, which I viewed but did not copy.
- The wiki page "Berserk" does not exist, ModEnc's Berserk page is empty, and https://cncnz.com/games/yuris-revenge/yuri/ returned "Page not found".
- The copy-check cannot normally read PDFs, but the YR manual PDF was already in its cache and was checked.
- Early in the session I briefly wrote two scratch text files one level above the workspace (<job folder>/j07-cncnz_*.txt); I deleted them at once, and no other workspace was opened.
